panel.label: SoftGlaze product tour
panel.trust: Profiles, cookies and logins stay on this computer.

free.title: Start with 25 browser profiles, free
free.body: No card and no time limit. Every new account can also try Pro free for 7 days.
free.alt: The Profiles page with ten profiles, their proxies and when each was last used

fingerprint.title: Each profile keeps its own fingerprint
fingerprint.body: Canvas, WebGL, fonts, audio and timezone are set per profile and stay the same on every launch. Give each one your own HTTP, HTTPS or SOCKS5 proxy.
fingerprint.alt: The Fingerprint tab of a profile next to its environment overview

ai.title: AI agents do the work, you approve it
ai.body: Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP apps run tasks in your profiles. You decide which actions need your approval, and every step is logged.
ai.alt: An approval request from Claude Desktop to fill in a sign-in form

phone.title: Approve requests from your phone
phone.body: The SoftGlaze phone app and web app show each request with its details. Allow it once, for an hour, or deny it. Included on every plan.
phone.alt: The Approvals screen on a phone with a request waiting for an answer

team.title: Work as a team with clear roles
team.body: Owner, Admin, Manager and Operator roles control who can see and open each profile. Pro includes 3 seats and Enterprise 25.
team.alt: The Members page with five team members and their roles
